name: Stumbling
overview: Scripture uses the concept of stumbling to illustrate both literal and figurative obstacles that hinder spiritual progress and obedience to God. God commands His people not to place stumblingblocks before the vulnerable, symbolizing the call to live righteously and fear the Lord (Leviticus 19:14). Christ is described as a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, revealing how His message can be a test of faith that separates true believers from those who reject Him (Isaiah 8:14). The Lord also warns of laying stumblingblocks before the disobedient, resulting in collective downfall, while urging His people to remove hindrances that impede their walk with Him (Jeremiah 6:21; Isaiah 57:14). Ultimately, those who love God's law experience great peace and are not easily offended or caused to stumble (Psalms 119:165).
